description: Skills for planning and building software products end to end.

plugins.name: venture-blueprint
plugins.description: Plans a software product or company from a rough idea, or none: brainstorms two or three paths with their own numbers and product imagery, then a full business plan with personas, competitors, projections, every department and validation experiments, told as a venture site you can read at a glance and present as a story; then, when asked, a build roadmap.
